notes.title: Patch v.1.00.19: 🍄 The Mushroom Sample Fix!
notes.content:
Here I am with another patch :) This one mainly focuses on the issues folks were having with the mushroom sample questline. It was acting up strangely where some of you weren’t able to deliver your last samples. To help that I’ve introduced a ✨new thing✨;

🍄 The Mushroom Board 🍄
This new sign can be found right next to Toph and will be where you can easily see all the various samples and their hints. You can also go to the board to deliver your samples (including those with save files where you previously couldn’t!). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/bf0b3cbc0a0c8c196508069f10261bb515714d0b.png

Samples you can deliver will show up as orange with three exclamation points and ones you haven’t found yet are dark brown with a question mark! To change into the various hats you can still go to the hat box.

The mushroom board is a much more clear and reliable way of handling the mushroom samples so I hope you enjoy it!

🎈 The after-party feature 🎈
I see a lot of folks are eager to keep playing after they’ve reached the end of the game and complete some of their final deliveries. Well now you can!

From now on,when you reload a save that you left in the party (or after the credits), it’ll put the game back to how it was before the party. You’ll still be in the location you last were but you’ll be able to go back to delivering your remaining letters!

Note for pre-existing save files:
There is ONE catch though! For those of you that have an existing save file from before this patch, you won’t be able to replay the party on that save file due to how your dialogue history saves. I’m really sorry about that but there’s nothing I can do to help that sadly.

🌟 Future plans 🌟
I’m not done with Mail Time yet! There’s a number of things in the works:

 The highly requested map feature (I’m working on it!!)
 Continue resolving bugs that come in via Discord/Steam Forums
 There’s additional content that I’d love to bring to you all in a content update(s).

No more info on that yet as I don’t want to announce anything until it’s ready but that’s  what I’m working on!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/f6e84cde9085fa4b52224e571e106efe09ea914d.png

Backing up your save
If you'd like to backup your save before playing the new patch (just in case), you can find it in the following location:

Windows: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/MailTime/Saved/SaveGames

Mac: ~/Library/Application Support/ Epic/MailTime/Saved/SaveGames

It will be called MailTime.sav so just copy that file to a save location! 

If you ever want to play on that file again just put it back in the folder, being careful to make sure the name is still MailTime.sav and you can start the game and play it.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/3f2630ebaa01bfc8b6f73c4ddb39828a30703dd7.png

💌 V1.00.19 💌
🔥MAJOR:
- introduced the sample board (next to Toph) where you can now deliver your mushroom samples and see all the hints (this should also fix save files where the mushroom quest got stuck)
- when at Greg's cave you can no longer accidentally trigger the dialogue that thinks you're at the van
- moved the parrot waxcap mushroom sample from the snowy end area to a new spot for better access, happy hunting!
- on a save file that's already played the epilogue party reloading the save (continue game) should allow you to continue playing.
- dialogue cameras for each NPC are pre-determined and so cannot clip into the player
- localised remaining untranslated text

⭐MEDIUM:
- moved the 'reset location' location in the pond area so you can't sequence break
- made sure when closing the handbook you regain focus to any other open UI
- prevented HUD from showing in Player Creation screen on new game
- the credits allow you to skip (still needs a bit more work to be solid with hovering and controller nav)
- removed quick start from the main menu to avoid confusion until it can be reworked.
- Express Delivery patch now actually counts seconds (not minutes). (there's still some work to be done here to make the patch more reliable as people are reporting it not working)
- controller navigation issues addressed across a bunch of UI screens
- Kaz no longer becomes unavailable during the Heist storyline as that could interfere with other -deliveries to him.
- fixed an issue where dialogue would never start in the opening sequence if you opened the handbook before it started the dialogue
- resolved a bug where two images in the credits would never show
- resolved errors in Korean translation

✨MINOR:
- fixed a deep hole in the terrain under the waterfall in the pond area
- made mycologist patch count samples delivered accurately
- when loading in a save in the epilogue the party tables won't be invisible
- reduced particles at the big waterfall near Jim & the snowy area
- secret admirer patch will show 1/1 when completed and hovering in the handbook
- introduced the publisher and developer logo to the main menu
- edited the credits to not mention Nintendo Switch or Playstation
- resolved dialogue tags showing in Janet's dialogue on the Japanese translation
- on first startup of the game the game will now attempt to sync with your PC's system language (if possible)
- parrot waxcap mushroom sample now has the correct UI art
- integrated some backend work for the upcoming map feature so that in future all save files will be able to support that. (also compatible with older save files)
- excluded confirm tab in handbook from bookmark cycle so it doesn't close accidentally when using Q/E (keyboard) or L/R (controller)
- renamed 'switch joysticks' to 'swap joysticks' in the settings for clarity
- resolved an issue where for some players not all water would load in
- prevented the game from loading double (reduces load on PC slightly)

∘₊✧────────────✧✿✿✿✧────────────✧₊∘

ty that's all! 

bye bye! <3 ヾ(•ᴗ•๑)o

Kela

notes.title: Mail Time September Update: Next Stop: The Station Area
notes.content:
hey everyone! I hope you're doing well <3
Today I'm bringing you our monthly update where I go a bit deeper into some stuff in the game for you to see :)
🍀 The Overgrown Station 🍀
Welcome to the very first area you'll see when you start a new game! Originally, you were going to arrive by train which is why I still call this the station  😅. Since then I've changed that to be the lovely mushroom van you might know from the demo. Regardless of the tracks being replaced by a road a lot of the vibes for this area were thought of very early on into development and I'm super happy with how it turned out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/d9062e1b61365857194ea39c1d4a0b2631630869.png

The above piece of art is actually from 18th of May 2021! Back then the game was going to be much much smaller but the idea for this really lush green area was already there :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/b6f9a19eeafc45ffd5f243bb313149636711dcba.png

Above you can see the initial terrain setup for a part of the Station area (behind the camera there's more you'll see later). The area is a bit lower down than Bark Burg in the back which meant that we needed some kind of path to bring you upwards. I felt this little path that snaked its way up would be quite cute! It also allows for a good vantage point to look over the station area and see some other things you might want to explore.
Once I have the general layout down with the terrain it's time to add all the foliage, props and other decoration!

notes.title: Timeline Update :(
notes.content:
hey everyone!
Hope you're doing well :) I'm here today to talk about timelines with you all.

We'd aimed for Mail Time’s release sometime 2022, specifically Q4 2022. It's become clear since the Kickstarter concluded that we'll need more time. Over the summer I noticed that implementing all the storylines and getting the game to the level of quality that I want will take longer than I had originally anticipated. That's why...

Mail Time's launch is being delayed

My vision for Mail Time has alway been and will continue to be that the quality of the game comes first. That means that I take a good look at the game every now and then to see where it’s lacking and it just needed more stuff in the world, more characters, more storylines, more polish, more charm.

Mail Time is all in all a pretty big production for the size of the dev team. I'm the only person full time and while I do get the amazing help from Gina, Maya, Bloo, Mischa & my publisher Freedom Games it still leaves a mountain of tasks for me to complete. I work as hard as I can but cannot sacrifice my health to get the game done quicker. It's better for both me and the game to give it the bit of extra time it needs. 

Mail Time will release sometime 2023.

At this time I won't be specifying a quarter or specific month because quite honestly I don't know. There's a lot at play and I currently don't know when exactly the game will be done for certain. When we do know we'll make an announcement but no sooner than that.

We're still looking to simultaneously release for Steam, Epic Games Store & Nintendo Switch. Making Mail Time available to everyone at the same time is very important to us and we'll be doing everything we can to make sure it does.

I deeply appreciate your patience and the overwhelming kindness you continue to show me!
I'm so so excited to share Mail Time with you when it's ready <3

Kela

notes.title: Mail Time August Update: Building out the Grumblewood Grove!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I hope you've had a great summer so far! I was able to tear myself away from my desk for a week to enjoy the sun in Italy (which was lovely) and now I'm back to it. So much has been happening on the game this past while that it's quite a writeup 😅

Let's go take a look! ^^

🌲 Bark Burg 🌲
as part of the Wholesome Direct we showed of the first of the new areas; Bark Burg!

[previewyoutube=WxUHAZX9_UQ;full][/previewyoutube]

⭐Welcome to Bark Burg⭐, the busy center of activity in the Grove where multiple critters have taken up residence. This has resulted in some neighborly problems you might be caught in the middle of!  

The dense trees house plenty of houses all connected by a network of hanging bridges, mushroom platforms and tricky swings to jump across. In order to deliver all your letters you're going to have to figure out ways to travel vertically and get up those trees! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/6344ad1ae4c9f88fde019e2f158097b5ee3100ed.png

As you probably know, the game is a tiny open world with 8 distinct areas. Each area has it's own vibe, inhabitants and trinkets to collect.
every area starts with a map like this:  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/d1dcd03603c5b47023a5b89bcb61633ad2e22da6.png

The map is where I establish the general layout, some interesting things in the area and the overall colour palette. I don't always stick to them perfectly as they're meant more as a starting point.  But, they do help to convey the vibe for each area to the whole team :)

ESPECIALLY the color pallete is important in this stage. The colour pallete will set the whole tone for the area as we only work with those colors for that area.  This is the main way we ensure each area is eadistinguishedished from another (besides theme of course). If you start encountering a new color grass you can be sure you're in unexplored lands!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/d2f349ca8c90c067aefc899acff73196fb29e419.png
very early image of Bark Burg :O

When I start putting things in the environments I can really see if things feel nice or have to move. I especially think a lot about what ways you'll be moving through the space. If a rock is really in the way I'll move it or if I'd want to jump up somewhere I'll make that possible. It's important that most ways you'd think about moving about the game would be possible (no jumps you can't quite make so you're not sure if it's possible).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/dc29ef2552f75cd0b53c71314e9bd66ddc7afcf2.png

Since this area has a big village aspect to it we needed lots of new props to fill it! Part of that is these cute chairs that can be recolored :)

Everything you see in the game starts out with a drawing like this to get an idea of what it's supposed to look like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/852ec1066e38277c4cfb0bc08ffc4a2e89571f8a.png

Doing these drawings allows me to hand off some of the work to Mischa Penders, the lovely 3D artist that's been helping me with all of the things that need to be made. It also is much faster to draw something than to fully make it in 3D so it's a cheap/fast way to figure out what something should look like :)

Sometimes there's a reference from children's books or other media for what I want but very often it's straight from my imagination! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/e25985a921a57c2ff882e896a5d67ce072a19d49.png

Putting all of this together lets me create these wonderfully intricate environments for you to explore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/fe2d62e0adf43cc596d5ad4abd8f7fd6e17df594.png

Putting together an area like this takes me quite some time, anywhere from 4 to 6 weeks. We need to prepare all the 3D models for the area (all areas have bespoke assets and some shared ones). I then need to import everything into the game engine and hand place almost everything is placed by hand and into the environment. 

While I do this, I switch to playing the game quite often to walk and jump around in order to make sure everything feels good. It's so much tweaking but it's really worth it when I can finally start taking these lovely screenshots! c:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/7ce6e547d2d2e22fa6e8d1ad1d87dcb8bffad645.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/d82f2164bcd3ec0d47276e80f9c2c2e02dfa40dd.png

🪑 Sitting!!! 🪑
You might've noticed it in the Wholesome Direct trailer and/or some of the screenshots already but you can now sit in the game! It's somehting I've been wanting to add for a while and was able to squeeze in just before we had to finish the trailer.

It all starts by animating the sitting. The animation is cut up into 3 distinct parts; sitting down, idling while sitting & standing up. That's so that I can play the sitting down once and then loop the idle until you want to stand up again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/8dbf747d77eb9389b9f7cddbee484bd692ae0d50.gif

Sitting down in-game simply happens by standing still for 10 seconds! That time can be adjusted in the settings to adjust to your liking (for example to shorten it if you want to go around sitting down everywhere for screenshots). The 10 second default will be adjusted as well based on the testing we'll do in the Beta together :)

You can stand up again by moving, very similar to how it works with the Animal Crossing sitting emote (if you know what that's like).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/bd0e2ea6600ee61dbea650853432909b1834bb2d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/69c864f98cfc8ec4058d2d482ca09736080248da.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/c9d149780fe31905169f412475ece74441608a5d.png

💬 dialogue icons 💬
I finally added a feature that I'd been thinking about for a while! The game already shows a character names in their associated color to allow you to easier remember who they are. However, I noticed while the demo was out for you all to play that quite a few of you still had trouble remembering who is who.

What I've done to negate this problem is add emojis! Now whenever a character is mentioned (and it makes sense in the context) a little emoji with their face will appear next to their name! That way you can know who is being talked about without having to remember 15+ characters! 😅

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/6162f4126e2081b782358ef38cd9025c533b50e5.gif

This is also integrated in the Handbook where you can keep track of all your deliveries!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/e9cfc9cda14db642b1008c3b8a601a61ce83328e.png

∘₊✧────────────✧✿✿✿✧────────────✧₊∘

that's it for today! thanks for reading if you made it all the way here!!


bye bye! <3  ヾ(•ᴗ•๑)o

Kela


🌈 Make sure to join the discord to come hang out with the whole community

notes.title: Mail Time May Update: 1 year anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello!

It’s been a WHILE since we’ve done an update damn 😳
With good reason though! Once the Kickstarter finished up I was a little down in the energy department and decided to prioritise development of the game while the social battery recharged. :)

BUT it’s been a little lonely not sharing what I’ve been doing so I figured I’d share a bit of a look into what I’ve been up to!

🎇1 YEAR anniversary of the Mail Time Discord!!🎇
Last week the Discord turned 1 year old and we’ve been celebrating with the community! Just a year ago the server had about 50 members in the first day (and omg was I excited) and now we’ve got over 8400 people there!

The Discord is a place I hang out pretty much every day and interact most with everyone in the community so to see it grow into this extremely kind and welcoming space has been incredible.
For the anniversary we have an exclusive role that you can get to signify you were part of the year 1 club! 😤🎉 If you make your way over there within the next few days you can still get it!

🎀 Kiki the cat 🎀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/4186429f3db86c23026ed43130745375fcbf9b24.png

Meet Kiki the cat! He might seem soft and cuddly but he’s actually very busy and it would be great if you could state your business and then leave? Thanks. Time is money. (and Kiki quite likes money)

You’ll meet Kiki when you’re delivering mail around the Grumblewood Grove as many critters in the area actually rent their houses from him. In true landlord fashion he’s unwilling to fix things and would rather never speak to his tenants. As much as this kitty puts up a ruthless front and is a pain to deal with, maybe he has a soft heart? Deep down… very deep down.

🍀 Player portraits 🍀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/a51415fc99ce57fa58de1a808e96fb7871953396.png

If you played the demo when we brought it back briefly for PAX East last month you’ll have already had a first look at this but I was finally able to finish all the art for the player portraits! So now no matter what configuration you decide on for your mail scout you’ll be represented as you should in dialogue.

✨ Sparking collectibles ✨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/38688dcf7d8192016a7c8e1487726a95aec38be5.gif

It had already been on my schedule for a bit and I was finally able to get to adding some shine and sparkle to the collectible pickups! This way they’re not only more special but also slightly easier to spot in the environment as there’s more movement going on. ✨

🐸 Dialogue Portraits 🐸
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/d5e067959be3e45064e93844853d5d27097cd3f1.png

I also spent WEEKS drawing the dialogue portraits for all the different characters in the game. There’s around 13 characters in the game with 12 portraits each so it came down to 156 individual drawings T_T

But, it does bring a lot of character to the game and helps convey the emotions of the conversations better so it’ll be worth it :’)

Those are the highlights! There’s also a whole bunch of small things that are not nearly as fun to look at + some SUPER SECRET stuff that I’m excited to share with you next month!

Bye bye ヽ(•ᴗ•๑)o

notes.title: Mail Time Demo Update - V.0.11.14

notes.title: Mail Time Demo Update - V.0.11.12
notes.content:

The Mail Time Kickstarter hit 100% funded this weekend! 😭💛 Thank you all so much for your support thus far and for giving all kinds of feedback on our demo. Based off of all of your feedback, I have another update for you all. Check out the patch notes here:

notes.title: Mail Time Kickstarter Date Reveal + Dev updates
notes.content:
Hii everyone!  (●’◡’●)ﾉ

I’m so SO EXCITED to announce that the Mail Time Kickstarter will be launching on FEBRUARY 15TH!!! We’re only a month away from it! (aaaaAAAaaAA)
Here’s just a small sneak peek at some of the amazing rewards you’ll be able to purchase: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/fbca3e1c194af83365a604bf1c22808b767c83b7.png

There’s no prototype YET and we still need to figure out the color we’ll be using but HYPE!!! You can get your VERY OWN MAIL SCOUT AAaaaAAahhh!!! 💌🎁 
Just imagine all of the cool pictures you could take of your mail scout hanging around, put them in a tree, put them next to your dog, put them in your backpack!! It’s so so cool to be able to offer plushies as a reward and we’ve been working really hard to make it possible. It’s probably the most requested merch item so you got it!! 

💖We’ll be consulting YOU on what colors to pick for the plushy so be sure to follow Mail Time on TikTok, Twitter or join the Discord!!

✿ Pre-save Mail Time on KICKSTARTER! ✿

✨Dev Updates ✨
First of all, happy New Years!! I’m back with the very first dev update of 2022 and I don’t want to make you TOO excited on top of the Kickstarter announcement but 2022 is the year Mail Time will launch!! I don’t know exactly when but I’m trying my darn hardest to get the game done and launched THIS YEAR.

So what have I been up to since December? I’d love to tell you 🐌☕️ ☕️🐛

🎮Controller support!🎮
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/eea3003f02e909450797435d2719a60e4830d2f0.gif

Mail Time now has full controller support 😎
It’s been a challenge to get working but it’s all set up now and you should be able to use pretty much any controller! Even if it isn’t immediately recognised and working you can also:

🕹️Rebind all the controls🕹️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/3a9307304a56ba090f0869430ccc8ab388ac7533.png

It’s been a huge headache to get working but I’m so happy to say that you’ll be able to rebind the controls. There’s still the final bits to do, hence the empty gaps in the UI, but you can rebind your controls to any input device you own. I can’t wait to see the steering wheel speedruns 😌

Now the most exciting thing everyone has been asking for:
🔘SLIDERS AND BUTTONS TO CHANGE THINGS WITH🔘
That’s right! Mail Time now has a settings menu B) I hadn’t actually thought that this would be a thing people would be excited about but damn everyone on Discord & the streams has been so excited about it. 

Some cool things it includes:
☀️Accessibility settings!☀️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/6b295dbe824c9d1ab644a2d106e53ea3c309346d.png

There’s various accessibility settings and I’m still adding more. I’m trying to get as many in there as I possibly can >:) Some highlights include the camera assist (which will allow you to play without a mouse if that’s difficult for you), showing the controls in the HUD for easy reminders and even giving yourself unlimited gliding stamina. 

Giving yourself unlimited stamina will impact the way the game is paced and isn’t necessarily the intended way but if you feel that you would not be able to play the game without it or would simply enjoy the game more like that it’s there!


🌈Pronouns🌈
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/683d2d0b845d3b9354ea18e0d13a8ef66eccdcc5.png

I had originally planned to never use any pronouns in the game for the player, which worked pretty well so far. But, it turns out that with different languages comes the fun realization that you can’t avoid gender everywhere. SO you can now pick your pronouns! ^U^ 

There’s the choice between she/her, he/him and they/them. Although, in certain languages they/them will not be available as the language doesn’t actually have a way for us to use gender neutral pronouns. But, for languages that do have that capability, you can be they/them ☺️

That’s it for now! :) Thanks so much for the support so far on the Kickstarter, we’re already at over 700 pre-saves which is amazing 💖

✿ Pre-save Mail Time on KICKSTARTER! ✿

If you want more of a behind the scenes look at the game, or to just be a part of our wholesome (and chaotic) Mail Time community, you should join our Discord!
ALSO don’t forget to wishlist Mail Time while you’re here on Steam :)) it helps me out A LOT 

Bye bye ヽ(•ᴗ•๑)o

notes.title: Mail Time December Update: Item Inventory
notes.content:
Hii!! 🍄

It’s ya girl back with another update 😌 TODAY I’ve got a whole NEW FEATURE for you (wow!! clap please)

BUT FIRST
🐸 Music Composer!!! 🐸
I’m over the moon to announce that Gina Loughlin will be the music composer for Mail Time! She’s so amazing as you can already hear in the Wholesome Snack Trailer we just released:

[previewyoutube=WuAoFQ9xFXk;full][/previewyoutube]
(pre-save on Kickstarter btw ;) )
 
We first met through our mutual love for Frogs and honestly I couldn’t imagine anyone doing a better job with the music than Gina. It’s better than I could’ve ever hoped and I can’t wait to share more of it with you!

✨the Patch system ✨
If you were ever in the Girl/Boy scouts (or have watched Up! By Pixar) you might be familiar with their badges. They’re little badges you earn to put on your uniform for completing certain tasks. I took that idea and added it to Mail Time! But I call them patches because it’s cuter 😤

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/ab0118cf97ada4bd7428740ae094eec567674e5f.gif

How it works is that when you complete one of the requirements for a patch (an achievement if you will ;) ) you get it swiftly delivered to you! This is probably my favourite UI I’ve done for the game so far. The way the letter bounces up is so fun to me (but that might just be me hahaha)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/e296b12ab19736814651773637d8dc67f21f6119.gif

Patches can now be viewed in this new tab of your Mail Scout Handbook where you can hover over any patch to view it’s requirements and how far you’ve progressed towards earning it!

🏅 Collect them all!! 🏅
There’s 24 patches for you to earn (and 100% complete the game). To get them all you’ll have to do various things from completing deliveries, talking to characters, discovering and collecting trinkets etc. There’s even one for breaking outside of the game area! The idea is to support different types of playstyles with the various patches you can get.

All patches will also be Steam achievements, allowing you to show of your skills to others of course ^U^

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/db36fcf2d1bb745c55c2a7f865b07f31c240d2fa.gif

The patches you earn are added to your HUD at the top left. This is not just because they’re pretty to look at but also because they serve a purpose!

🍃 Gliding stamina 🍃
You now need to collect patches to be able to glide for longer! Each patch adds a little bit of stamina to your gliding :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/0a621c6088ebcf6e68dd3ece2ad54f313dd6e485.gif

When you run out of stamina you let go of your letter and fall to the ground. No worries though! The game doesn’t have fall damage so you’ll be fine. You regain your patches as soon as you touch down on the ground or any other surface so you can try again!

🧨NEW CHARACTER 🧨

Let me introduce you all to Swomp:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/23778af8b5b5296f6a80cc3f7727c31eb07f2bd5.gif

Swomp is a crime rat with a concerning lack of brain cells. What crimes is he up to with his ‘boomstick’??? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/67d768d1d5d5becd2852ee3a835a5eee0ff93063.gif

That’s it for now! :) Thanks for the AMAZING response to the Wholesome Snack trailer + Kickstarter announcement!! I was super nervous about it but the amount of love so far has been incredible <3 

PRE SAVE HERE 

 If you want more of a behind the scenes look at the game, or to just be a part of our wholesome (and chaotic) Mail Time community, you should join our Discord!
ALSO don’t forget to wishlist Mail Time while you’re here on Steam :)) it helps me out A LOT

notes.title: Mail Time October Update: Item Inventory!
notes.content:
Hello!! 🐸
Here to share what I’ve been working on for the past 2 months :)
I share semi-regular sneak peaks in the Mail Time Discord but now I want to go a bit more in-depth. Let’s get into it!

Is that?? Could it be(e)??

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/085ca71b0b75e68a1c5887b95a7c27349a2587f4.gif

✨A wild bee appeared!!!✨ 🐝

There’s now a friend! Kinda. 
I heard you asking for pets (pls my phone was overheating from all the notifications) and while that would be a bit weird in a game where you deliver mail to animals I want to introduce you to Bee! 
Bee is a.. well, bee and when you encounter them in the game you quickly become friends. Bee will follow you around for much of the game, occasionally offering words of wisdom:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/c2311d34be4c01b47bf551f1a50685140439129c.gif

So smart 😔

BUT at other times Bee will leave you because it has found more interesting things to do. They are easily distracted by all kinds of things and will sometimes disappear only to reappear later. 
I wonder what would happen if you followed them???

MOVING ON >:)

For all the hoarders- I mean ‘collectors’ - out there you can now stuff all kinds of random trinkets in your backpack!! Introducing:

✨the inventory ✨

For example, let’s say you to talk to our man Jim: He wants a bottlecap. Okay, we can do that! You’ll have to go looking around to see if you can find the item you need.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/4e60f4dd7526f3449430791161468e77c9bcba42.gif

And when you find it all you have to do is get close to it to collect the item! As you find more and more trinkets they’ll start to move much more subtly, making them more difficult to find. Of course finding everything will get you an achievement ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/4f7f44c7361467c6a80f26e47b86581af6a7fd4a.gif

Whenever you collect an item you’ll see this beautiful UI screen which was created with ideas from you all and I absolutely love (although this is such a pain to keep looking nice on different aspect ratio screens TuT). Also excuse the lack of a bottlecap drawing, it’s on my list haha. This sparkle patch is just a placeholder!

Much of the inventory system was done while streaming on Twitch! It’s been my favourite way to get immediate feedback from the community and suggestions on new features. If you want to see the VODs of those streams you can find it here & here :)

Throughout November I’ll be streaming a lot more so join me there if you want to help make the game and watch me work!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/59bd9390002bb52f2a5b010bfe5234ef8225d676.gif

Now that we have the bottlecap we can go back to Jim and give it to him. He even gives us a reward for our effort 💖🍓

New areas??
I’m not going to be showing too much yet because it’s still very much in the early stages BUT I wanted to show you some color palettes for different areas of the game I’m working on :))

Right now the game only has a prototype of 1 of the 7-8 areas I want to eventually have; the yellow flower field (middle of the second row). I’m trying to go all over the rainbow to have different vibes for everything! What areas do you think will be the different colours? Come speculate in the discord: discord.gg/mailtime

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/e7cbdb9b38f1ee8fb52a14b3776c38ad51d28d90.png

With the inventory system I felt the game also needed an updated pause menu that could give you a lot more information about what you can do in the game. 

The Mail Scout Handbook
You receive from the Mail Scouts (who you work for) an official Mail Scout Handbook to track your deliveries and other things (coming soon) in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/1cf1f8834641ed4e76a77a1cf941424419d13cc6.gif

You can see all the deliveries you need to do as well as if any items are needed in order to complete the delivery. A different letter icon is in front of a delivery depending on if the delivery still needs any items :)

At a different bookmark you can open the save menu where you can manually save and load the game (although the game will also automatically save for you)!

You can also quit the game from here :( (although really why would you ever want to?? Just play forever, what’s the problem???)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/c0bb562985385a5e3c0b7ef6ced8ad6ae9ef1071.gif

That’s it for the handbook FOR NOW!!! There’s still some pretty important tabs that will be added in the future. It’s nice to have this more expandable system to put things in rather than having to make endless menus for different functions. 

Now you can all find it in your trusty Mail Scout Handbook! (property of the Mail Scouts, damage will have to be paid!! >:( )

That’s it for now! :) Thank you all for your support so far throughout development (I reached 100k on TikTok this month what O.O)! If you want more of a behind the scenes look at the game, or to just be a part of our wholesome (and chaotic) Mail Time community, you should join our Discord!

Don’t forget to wishlist Mail Time while you’re here on Steam :)) it helps me out A LOT

notes.title: Mail Time Publisher Announcement + Dev Updates
notes.content:
Hi besties! 
I have some exciting news to share! Mail Time is now being published by Freedom Games ( https://freedom.gg ). For those of you who may not know, a game publisher not only provides additional investment and funding for developing the game, but also takes care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing the store pages and potential console release process, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. Really it lets me totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides me with the resources to do so. 

You may also be worried about horror stories of publishers ruining the vision of a game or forcing arbitrary restrictions on the dev team. For Freedom, that can’t be further from the reality we have experienced with them. Freedom has been an amazing partner to me, only enhancing and supporting my vision. I selected Freedom because they are committed to my vision of the game, and only want to see it reach its full potential as I see it. I maintain complete creative and development freedom, and Freedom (heh) wouldn’t have it any other way.

Dev Updates
Now to get into some updates as to what all I’ve been working on lately for Mail Time! A lot of what I’ve been working on has been about player customization. 

I started off with adding customization for the player’s backpack. Here’s a look at what those new options are that you’ll be able to pick from in game. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/0a40fb2283cb973e98a8dd010c8f82e251d22927.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/d056f43373c39a0825f5fe130c9b8317a53d32b3.gif

Next I finished adding in all of the different hairstyles and colors.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/54fec66781e50aa84fb513e3ef13c80f23baabb4.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/df432b08974cf3f301b66ebd0c682ea343e40093.gif

I also added in skin color customization as well as different outfits to choose from!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/07d3d3d48be593e7663b355de2eb78c0b896ab4c.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827766/61f8f7bec31ab0c3836821a7bf8dc1e6e916a1b4.gif

Thank you all for your support so far throughout development! If you want more of a behind the scenes look at the game, or to just be a part of our fantastic Mail Time community, you should join our Discord. Also don’t forget to wishlist Mail Time while you’re here on Steam.
